judge.rationale: The candidate has a fatal TypeScript/AJV v8 bug in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`: it accesses `err.dataPath` on AJV v8 `ErrorObject` (instead of `err.instancePath`), which does not exist in AJV v8 types (`typecheck` will fail) and evaluates to `undefined` at runtime, causing the wrong-type test to fail because the property name `ssn` is omitted from the formatted error message. Additionally, using default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` in an ES module with `NodeNext` resolution typically fails `tsc` without named import `{Ajv}`. The attempt appears to have stopped mid-flight (leaving `.lore/dod.md` and `registry.acceptance.test.ts` tracked in the working tree), missing all required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) and producing an incomplete `CHANGELOG.md`. It also misses most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool throw) and puts the orchestrator test in an unrequested acceptance test file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
